definitions.explanation: To clean a surface by rubbing with a cloth or paper.

examples.japanese: テーブルを{拭|ふ}いてください。
{涙|なみだ}を{拭|ふ}いて{笑顔|えがお}を{見|み}せた。
examples.english: She wiped away her tears and showed a smile.

examples.japanese: タオルで{体|からだ}を{拭|ふ}いた。
examples.english: I dried my body with a towel.

notes:
{拭|ふ}く is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) for wiping surfaces clean or dry.

ASPECT (ている):
{拭|ふ}いている indicates wiping is in progress.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [surface]を{拭|ふ}く — to wipe [surface]
- [moisture/dirt]を{拭|ふ}く — to wipe away [moisture/dirt]
- [cloth]で{拭|ふ}く — to wipe with [cloth]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {汗|あせ}を{拭|ふ}く (wipe sweat)
- {涙|なみだ}を{拭|ふ}く (wipe tears)
- {床|ゆか}を{拭|ふ}く (wipe/mop the floor)
- {拭|ふ}き{掃除|そうじ} (wiping/mopping)

DO NOT CONFUSE:
- {拭|ふ}く (to wipe) — different from:
- {吹|ふ}く (to blow)
- {噴|ふ}く (to spout)

All three can be read ふく but have different meanings.

RELATED WORDS:
- {雑巾|ぞうきん} (cleaning rag)
- {拭|ふ}き{取|と}る (to wipe off)
